vacancy_energetics.provenance: Li, Guo & Robertson, J. Phys. Chem. C 119 (2015), DOI 10.1021/acs.jpcc.5b02430. Absolute neutral V_O formation energies on rutile (110): sX 4.39 / 4.98 / 5.70 eV, GGA 3.71 / 4.10 / 4.79 eV (surface / first subsurface / bulk). Relative values are used; the oxygen chemical potential cancels in the canonical ensemble. Site energies are polaron-relaxed: Ti3+ small polarons are not explicit variables (context: Reticcioli et al., Phys. Rev. B 98 (2018) 045306).

surface_ordering.pair_table_note: Pair energies are calibrated, not computed: chosen so that spacings of 1-2 bridging sites are suppressed and the modal spacing near critical coverage is 4-5 sites, with the ordering energy scale of the published low-energy configurations (~0.2-0.3 eV). Replace with project DFT configuration energies when available.
surface_ordering.provenance: Birschitzky, Reticcioli et al., npj Comput. Mater. 10 (2024), DOI 10.1038/s41524-024-01289-4. DFT+U (U = 3.9 eV) + ML + Metropolis MC on rutile (110): computed critical coverage 16.7%, reconstruction threshold ~20%, interaction range ~10 A, in-row spacings of 1-2 sites nearly absent, most probable spacing 4-5 sites.

saturation.note: Beyond ~20% bridging-O vacancy coverage the (1x2) reconstruction takes over; the model pins surface content at the threshold instead of describing the reconstructed phase. x_max is the approximate rutile point-defect range before crystallographic shear planes.

co2_kinetics.note: Placeholder effective kinetics: k_c = A_c p^m exp(-Ea_c/kT), P_c(t) = 1 - exp(-k_c t). The barriers are the first-sketch values; the prefactors are EFFECTIVE, far below an attempt frequency for the deeper classes because subsurface and bulk refill are transport-limited, and are set to give a plausible recovery pattern at 600 C / 300 s / 0.2 atm (surface complete, subsurface partial, bulk negligible). Replace with fitted or DFT values; none of these numbers is a literature result.

dielectric_correlation.note: Empirical dielectric loss factor of this work: linear regression of log10(eps'') on log10(VO_total), i.e. eps'' = 10^a * VO^b with a = -3.07028 +/- 0.695 and b = 1.22355 +/- 0.2302 (OriginLab, no weighting, N = 4, Pearson r 0.96637, R^2 0.93388, adj. R^2 0.90082, RSS 0.18029). Fitted over roughly 95-5000 umol-O/g; below that range the value is an extrapolation and the card marks it. Set eps_prime to display tan delta.
dielectric_correlation.provenance: Measured in this work (Kwak et al.): dielectric loss factor vs total oxygen-vacancy content from H2O-integration titration of reduced rutile.

experimental_recovery.note: Measured CO2 recovery for the overlay on the sweep plot; empty until digitised from experiment.

diffusion_eV.note: Stored for a later kinetic version; not used by the equilibrium model. The surface-to-subsurface exchange barrier is a different path and is not any of these numbers. The planned kinetic layer follows the coarse-grained kinetic Monte Carlo framework of the group: radial coarse cells over the particle, Arrhenius exchange rates, detailed balance against the same Gibbs measure, q^2 time coarse-graining.
diffusion_eV.provenance: Bulk: Iddir et al., J. Phys. Chem. C (2010), DOI 10.1021/jp107986a. Surface (unstrained rutile 110): Wang et al., Phys. Rev. B 82 (2010) 165309. Coarse-grained KMC framework: Katsoulakis & Vlachos, J. Chem. Phys. 119, 9412 (2003), DOI 10.1063/1.1616513; Katsoulakis, Majda & Vlachos, Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. USA 100, 782 (2003).
